title: Spectrality and eigen sets of infinite convolutions and random measures generated by admissible pairs
summary: In this paper, we construct a class of random measures $μ^{\mathbf{n}}$ by infinite convolutions. Given admissible pairs $\{(N_{k}, B_{k})\}_{k=1}^{m}$ and a sequence $\bn=\{n_{k}\}_{k=1}^{\infty}$ of positive integers, for every $\bw\in Ω$, we write $μ^{\mathbf{n}}(\bw) = δ_{N_{ω_{1}}^{-n_{1}}B_{ω_{1}}} * δ_{N_{ω_{1}}^{-n_{1}}N_{ω_{2}}^{-n_{2}}B_{ω_{2}}} * \cdots$. First, we show that the mapping $μ^{\mathbf{n}}: (\bw, B) \mapsto μ^{\mathbf{n}}(\bw)(B)$ is a random measure.
